prompt: A young Western female street photographer walks through a lively downtown street and notices an elderly man sitting outside a café with his small dog. She carefully composes the candid moment through her camera, captures the photo, then turns the camera toward the viewer to proudly show the shot she just took. She smiles, says “Look at that,” then continues walking through the city. Ultra-photorealistic visuals, natural handheld documentary movement, realistic camera interaction, authentic facial expressions, accurate hand movements, realistic dog behavior, natural daylight, cinematic depth of field, continuous character consistency, immersive city ambience, premium documentary realism.
